items.docs:
Lists all permissions defined for your Tenable Vulnerability Management container.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Creates a permission that grants the specified actions to the specified subjects on the specified objects. **Note:** The `AllAssets` object type is only compatible with `CanView`, `CanScan`, or empty actions. The `Tag` and `AllTags` object types are only compatible with `CanUse` and `CanEdit` actions.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: permission_uuid
params.description: Specifies the unique identifier (UUID) of the permission.

items.docs:
Retrieves the details for the specified permission.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: permission_uuid
params.description: Specifies the unique identifier (UUID) of the permission to update.

items.docs:
Updates the specified permission. **Note:** This method overwrites the existing permission data. You must include all fields in the request body, not just the fields you want to change.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: permission_uuid
params.description: Specifies the unique identifier (UUID) of the permission to delete.

items.docs:
Deletes the specified permission.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: user_uuid
params.description: Specifies the unique identifier (UUID) of the user to list permissions for.

items.docs:
Returns the permissions for the specified user. **Note:** In the response, the `permissions_granted` array lists all permissions granted to the specified user, and the `permissions_available` array lists all permissions available but not applied to the specified user.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: user_group_uuid
params.description: Specifies the unique identifier (UUID) of the user group to list permissions for.

items.docs:
Returns the permissions for the specified user group. **Note:** In the response, the `permissions_granted` array lists all permissions granted to the specified user group, and the `permissions_available` array lists all permissions available but not applied to the specified user group.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Returns the permissions assigned to the current user. **Note:** The subjects in the response are redacted to return only the current user and the user groups the current user belongs to. The `permissions_available` array is always empty for this endpoint.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).
